title: platform/language.json
description: This dealer's language switch settings, baked by the platform on every publish. Platform-owned and regenerated wholesale. Absent, or enabled false, means no switch and no Google code: the build is identical to one made before the plugin existed.

enabled.description: Defaults to true when the file is present.

languages.description: Language codes the switch offers. English is always offered first, whether listed or not. Defaults to ["en", "es"].
